items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know what the hell they was talking about. I found out later that was one of the best vaudeville acts that ever happened, the Tennessee Ten.

ctx.x: ...Petit, Buddy Petit... See he goes off, and he's with... He goes to Chicago and he's with King Oliver. Gee whiz! Then he leaves King Oliver and he goes with the Tennessee Ten. I didn't know what the hell they was talking about. I found out later that was one of the best vaudeville acts that ever happened, the Tennessee Ten. You know about them.
I've heard the name. I didn't see them.
